replay_method: Use only the root signed OR3 language and explicit closure witnesses to re-establish the absence of every frozen Schaefer tractable basis. Separately re-check the positive/negative occurrence equality identity from the permanent binary palette split.

source_identity.pair_states: x_i,d_i in {1,2}; ~x_i is the opposite binary color of x_i

root_relations.POS: R_plus={0,1}^3 minus {000}; equivalently e1 OR e2 OR e3
root_relations.NEG: R_minus={0,1}^3 minus {111}; equivalently not e1 OR not e2 OR not e3

explicit_schaefer_exclusions.horn: R_plus contains 100 and 010 but their coordinatewise AND 000 is excluded
explicit_schaefer_exclusions.dual_horn: R_minus contains 110 and 101 but their coordinatewise OR 111 is excluded
explicit_schaefer_exclusions.bijunctive: R_plus contains 100,010,001 but their majority is 000, excluded
explicit_schaefer_exclusions.affine: R_plus contains 110,101,011 but their minority/XOR is 000, excluded

conclusion: The two-relation root sublanguage {R_plus,R_minus} already lies in none of the six frozen Schaefer tractable classes. Therefore the larger 70-relation signed E4 catalog also has no common frozen Schaefer basis.

positive_escape_replay.condition: If one global orientation bit r_i matches all occurrence polarities of each equality variable, define e_i'=e_i xor r_i.
positive_escape_replay.effect: All occurrence bits become q=e_i' and the E4/C10 upward carrier applies unchanged.

barrier_replay.source_bound: Apply the already sealed Boolean Schaefer dichotomy only after the exact relation language has been established.
barrier_replay.consequence: Unrestricted CSP over the genuinely mixed signed root language is NP-complete; a polynomial exact carrier for every connected unrestricted instance would imply P=NP.
barrier_replay.firewall: No P!=NP conclusion and no impossibility theorem for polynomial carriers.
